ModelAnim2 is the tree's coined name for the cartridge's dExtAnm2Model_c (_ZTI15dExtAnm2Model_c at 0x0208e788, single inheritance from dExtAnmModel_c, the tree's ModelAnim). The fold takes the method run and the lifecycle tail D0, D1, C1 (0x02016320..0x020163e0). ~ModelAnim2() is the key function. RTTI is off so the coined dExtAnm2Model_c records are not emitted. The mask is the same rule as arm9/BlendModelAnim.

func_0201628c and func_020162a4 keep their address names and int parameters: Player calls both through an extern (int, int) declaration on a body model with bone 8, so a typed ModelAnim2* parameter would add a declaration disagreement. func_02045e2c is declared with an int frame, matching the ROM's unextended lsr #16 argument; Model4.cpp defines it with short, the same banked disagreement the absorbed source carried.

Func_020162C4 keeps the mangled extern "C" definition for the Fix12<int> by-value wall (6az), as ModelAnim::SetAnim does; ModelAnim2.h's member declaration is the real one. The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen. The constructor and destructor are first in the source so their clusters land after the methods.
